# H06 evidence / Протокол H06

Manual review: **PASS (HW OBSERVED)** for the four Output Recall points. This does not promote the feature to HW VERIFIED or claim calibrated metrology.

## Reviewer assessment — 2026-10-26

| Case | Recall / saved outputs | Panel after cycle | `CHAN:OUTP?` after cycle | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OFF_111 | OFF / 111 | 000 | 000 | PASS |
| ON_101 | ON / 101 | 101 | 101 | PASS |
| ON_010 | ON / 010 | 010 | 010 | PASS |
| ON_000 | ON / 000 | 000 | 000 | PASS |

All cycles used Independent topology, no jumpers or attached load, and Save Last ON. Each boot snapshot was captured before any profile or output write. At every boot, the readback retained CH1/CH2/CH3 setpoints 1.00/1.50/2.00 V, currents 0.100/0.200/0.300 A, voltage limits 2.00/3.00/4.00 V, and timer OFF. Every one of the 970 `SYST:ERR?` responses was `0, "No error"`. Output Recall was restored OFF, Save Last remained ON, and the operator confirmed physical outputs and load OFF.

The raw `*IDN?` revision field appeared as both `1.04-0.01` and `1.04-1.04` during this run; manufacturer/model/serial identity checks passed on every transport session. The operator-reported menu firmware is Main 1.04 / Aux 0.01. The revision-field variation is preserved as an observation and is not interpreted as a firmware change.

No library production code change was required: the existing `output_states()` readback and serial-bound reconnect provided the required path. The settings themselves remain panel-configured because the reference manual does not document SCPI control for Output Recall or Save Last.
